title: Modular quadruped
alt: Revised SolidWorks assembly of the twelve-joint quadruped.
summary: A twelve-joint robot built with teammates, from printed mechanisms to kinematics and motor control.
stage: Hardware built; walking control in development
lede: I work on the mechanical design and control software for a twelve-joint quadruped, using CAD, printed prototypes, and handwritten derivations to guide each revision.
hero_caption: Our revised quadruped CAD, showing the frame, actuators, and leg layout.

sections.title: Testing one leg at a time

title: Cycloidal actuators
alt: Cycloidal actuator CAD with a circular output flange and printed enclosure.
summary: Printed robotic joints, revised to improve efficiency and back-driving through output-shaft design and gear clearance.
lede: I developed printed cycloidal actuators for the quadruped, then revised the output-shaft structure and gear-profile clearance after early prototypes resisted back-driving.
hero_caption: Cycloidal actuator CAD with the printed housing and output mounting pattern.

sections.title: When the first reducer would not back-drive

title: Electronics & motor control
alt: Unpopulated prototype controller PCB fitted to a printed actuator housing.
summary: Prototype controller boards, encoder circuits, and CAN software for the robot’s motors.
lede: I worked on controller-board development and the firmware and CAN interfaces that connect the robot’s software to its motors.
hero_caption: An unpopulated prototype controller PCB fitted to the actuator housing to check its size and mounting.

sections.title: From a controller board to a motor command
Board bring-up and the next revision

title: Planetary QDD design
alt: Quasi-direct-drive actuator CAD exposing the sun, planet, and ring gears.
summary: A planetary actuator CAD study focused on reduction ratio, gear geometry, and compact packaging.
lede: After working with cycloidal joints, I began exploring a lower-reduction planetary actuator and the tradeoffs between torque, responsiveness, and packaging.
hero_caption: A cutaway of the planetary QDD design study, showing how the gears fit inside the motor package.

title: Simulation & control
alt: CAD-derived quadruped model in a dark MuJoCo scene.
summary: Leg kinematics derived by hand and checked in code, alongside a CAD-based simulation model.
lede: I derive the leg models, compare coordinate conventions, and check the mathematics before using it in the controller.
hero_caption: The CAD-derived quadruped model in MuJoCo, used for modeling and control experiments.

title: ROV thruster design
alt: CAD design of a ducted propeller for a remotely operated underwater vehicle.
summary: A ducted underwater thruster developed through CAD, flow simulation, and prototype testing.
lede: As mechanical design lead, I developed a ducted ROV thruster and worked with the electrical team to fabricate, integrate, and test it.
hero_caption: The duct, propeller, and mounting structure of the ROV thruster CAD.
